output.summary: KEP-2593 proposed a new CIDR allocator for NodeIPAM, controlled by a new ClusterCIDR resource, to allocate multiple discontiguous pod CIDR blocks with node affinity and per-node block sizes. The KEP was withdrawn and the feature is to be developed out of tree.
output.rationale: The current NodeIPAM allocates each node a fixed-size range from one cluster CIDR that must be sized up front, which wastes addresses and cannot be extended without restart. The proposal added a ClusterCIDR-driven allocator to support multiple discontiguous blocks, node affinity, and variable block sizes. The readme states the KEP was withdrawn and the feature will move out of tree, referencing a sig-network mailing list thread; the excerpt does not give further reasoning.
output.outcome_reason: The readme says: "THIS KEP HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN AND THIS FEATURE WILL BE DEVELOPED OUT OF TREE". It links a sig-network mailing list thread, but the excerpt does not summarize the reasons for the move.

alternatives.option: Keep the feature in-tree under this KEP
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the KEP was withdrawn and the feature will be developed out of tree; no in-tree reason is given in the excerpt.

evidence.quote: IMPORTANT: THIS KEP HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN AND THIS FEATURE WILL BE DEVELOPED OUT OF TREE
This proposal enhances how pod CIDRs are allocated for nodes by adding a new CIDR allocator that can be controlled by a new resource 'ClusterCIDR'.
The size is specified during cluster startup time and cannot be modified later on.
